{{Infobox auto|renewable=Yes}}
'''Tattered leather''' is a common crafting material, the pack's name for the {{MCW|Rabbit Hide|rabbit hide}}. It replaces {{MCW|Rotten Flesh|rotten flesh}} as the main drop of [[Zombie|zombies]], and is used to make leather armor and to craft {{ItemLink|Sturdy Leather}}, so players can get leather without raising cattle.

== Obtaining ==
=== Mob loot ===
Tattered leather is dropped by [[Zombie|zombies]], [[Drowned|drowned]], zombie villagers and [[Zombified Piglin|zombified piglins]] (only when killed by a player), and by rabbits and sheep. Sheep drop 1–3 tattered leather instead of wool.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/entities/sheep.json}}</ref>

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
One piece of sturdy leather can be cut back into 4 tattered leather.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/rabbit_hide_from_leather.json}}</ref>

=== Other sources ===
{{Sources}}

== Usage ==
=== Crafting ingredient ===
{{Uses}}
As in vanilla, 4 tattered leather make 1 sturdy leather. The pack's leather armor (the Leather Hood, Leather Pauldron, Leather Pants and Leather Boots) is crafted directly from tattered leather.

=== Repairing ===
[[Sturdy leather armor]] can be repaired with tattered leather.

A [[Fox Pelt|fox pelt]] is the same item with a different name and texture, so it works in all of these recipes.
